summary: This is a project on NASA's rover, Opportunity. We have developed a comic portraying a short story based on Opportunity—affectionately nicknamed "Oppy"—of its last moments, and the various accomplishments it has made to further research into Mars. The project addresses the challenge by bringing in an accessible way for young children to learn about Oppy and its accomplishments before it went silent in 2018. It is important as it not only educates the youth, but also appreciates the countless hours put into developing Opportunity by scientists. This was a river estimated to only last about 90 Mars days, but ended up lasting 15 years instead.
details: Our project helps young students get a breif idea about the rover oppurtunity.We made in a comic styled video which makes it interesting for young students rather than providing raw information.Our goal is to make the young students understand that science cannot always go as predicted as the intended days for the mars rover oppurtunity was just 90 days but it lasted for over 14 years. Our project did not us digital art tools and each and every painting and picture was drawn and painted by hand which makes our project stand out .Our project considered oppy as an person with feelings rather than just a rover ,this feature makes younger students and audience interested in our project.Our project might not be perfect as it is our first time but we gave it all our best .
